text.p: Health-Chem Corp said on Friday a total of 952,520 shares of common stock were subscribed for in a subscription rights offering.

The company said in a statement the shares were subscribed for at $1.10 per share. As a result of the offering, the company's shares outstanding has risen to about 5.4 million shares from about 4.4 million shares.

The number of shares subscribed for represented more than 75 percent of the shares in the offering which had been subject to the company's rights to repurchase from Marvin M. Speiser, the chief executive and largest shareholder.

Noting that delays in the effective date of the Offering had reduced the economic value conferred on shareholders, Speiser has voluntarily waived his right to have such repurchase rights terminate as to shares not subscribed for. As a consequence, the balance of about 317,400 shares remains subject to the Company's repurchase rights.
Health-Chem is the parent company of Transderm Laboratories Corp.
